audit.why: Riot's Q text: slows, damages, and reduces the resistances of all hit — that shred amplifies every point of damage that follows it. Pool grants 2s untargetability, which is exactly long enough to sit out her R rain.
audit.corrected: Q shred and the missing-health scaling on Starfire Spellblade written into spikes[0]; the Pool-eats-the-nova line written into spikes[1].
